title: An Amazing Animal
description: Practise comparatives, superlatives and relative clauses, then describe an amazing animal.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your description in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: 🐘 The elephant is the ___ animal on land.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the adjective in brackets.
exercises.text: 🐆 A cheetah is ___ (fast) than a horse.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Dolphins live in groups called pods.
exercises.explanation: Subject + verb + in + groups: Dolphins live in groups called pods.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: A giraffe is an animal ___ has a very long neck.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: A rabbit is more small than a dog.
answers: A rabbit is smaller than a dog.

exercises.prompt: Write who, which or where.
exercises.text: A zoo is a place ___ we can see wild animals.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Penguins are birds, but they ___ fly.
exercises.explanation: "But" shows a surprise: penguins are birds but they can't fly.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: The blue whale is the biggest animal in the world.
exercises.explanation: The blue whale is the biggest animal in the world.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: An owl ___ at night and sleeps in the day.

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word SLOWER. Begin: "A ..."
exercises.text: A snail is not as fast as a tortoise.
answers: A snail is slower than a tortoise.
exercises.explanation: "A is not as fast as B" means "A is slower than B".

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: 🦁 I have ___ (see) a real lion at the zoo.
exercises.explanation: Present perfect = have + past participle. The past participle of see is seen.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: With he, she or it add -s: it sleeps.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: This animal ___ be a fish or a frog. I am not sure.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: It has got big ears and a long trunk.
exercises.explanation: It has got big ears and a long trunk.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Octopuses are clever ___ they can open jars.

exercises.prompt: Write much or many.
exercises.text: 🐜 Ants are small, but there are very ___ of them.

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word TALLEST. Begin: "The ..."
exercises.text: No other bird is as tall as an ostrich.
answers: The ostrich is the tallest bird.
exercises.explanation: "No other ... is as tall as" means "the tallest".

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Frogs can live in water and on the land, but they lay eggs at water.
answers: Frogs can live in water and on the land, but they lay eggs in water.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: If we ___ trees, many animals will lose their homes.
exercises.explanation: After "if" use the present simple: if we cut down.

exercises.prompt: Write should or shouldn't.
exercises.text: 🐯 We ___ look after wild animals and their homes.

task.prompt: Write about an amazing animal. Tell your friend about it.
contentPoints: Say what the animal is and where it lives.
Say what it eats or can do.
task.modelAnswer: My amazing animal is the dolphin. It lives in the sea and it swims in groups. It has got a smooth grey body and a long nose. Dolphins can jump very high and they eat fish. They are amazing because they are very clever and friendly. They can talk to each other with special sounds. I would love to see a dolphin one day.
